dogecoin.text:
There is a beautiful irony in memes being a store of value and source of generational wealth for milennials and gen z 

Send it $wif $doge $boden

Awhile back vitalik wrote an article on social tokens and how we will use crypto to incentivize social values. 

I believe #memecoins are this idea playing out. 

From $DOGE and $WIF as funny “memes” to $BODEN and $USA political ideologies 

I think this is just the beginning
